title: caveman toggle state (v1)
description: Per-project caveman feature toggle. Single source of truth at <project>/.ai-playbook/caveman.json. Read/written exclusively through scripts/caveman/toggle.py. UI consumers MUST go through the CLI (python -m scripts.caveman) rather than touching the file directly.

schema.description: Schema versioning hook. MUST be 'caveman-toggle/v1' for this version. Future bumps require a migration script under scripts/caveman/migrations/.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false, all components are inert regardless of their individual flags.

mode.description: Intensity level for response_style. Only consulted when components.response_style is true.

response_style.description: Inject the caveman ruleset block into AGENTS.md (materialise) and enable per-turn reinforcement hook.

compress_docs.description: Capability flag — does NOT auto-compress. Gates the /caveman-compress skill and the `caveman compress <file>` CLI subcommand.

subagents_cavecrew.description: Allow Claude to delegate to cavecrew-investigator/builder/reviewer subagents when applicable.

commit_caveman.description: Enable the caveman-commit skill (terse Conventional Commits).

review_caveman.description: Enable the caveman-review skill (one-line PR review).

mcp_shrink.description: Wrap MCP server commands with caveman-shrink to compress tool descriptions in flight. Requires Node + npx. Backed up before mutation.

components.description: Per-component flags. Allows the UI to render six independent toggles. response_style/mcp_shrink are persistent state; compress_docs/commit_caveman/review_caveman are capability gates for on-demand skills.

applied_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last write. Used by audit/telemetry.

applied_by.description: Identifier of the agent/user that last toggled state. Optional. Sourced from $USER / $USERNAME by the CLI; UI consumers should set explicitly.
